NONE: › to drop down to a lower level in the middle
（中間部位）下垂，下陷
› to become weaker
減弱；下降，下跌

S or U: › [ S or U ] a movement or position in which something has dropped down to a lower level
下垂部分；下彎部分；下陷部分
C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] a reduction in something

example: The shelf sagged under the weight of the heavy books.
書架被沈重的書壓彎了。
The dollar held up well this morning but the pound sagged.
今天上午美元走挺，但英鎊下跌了。
